title: Kiro — AI Coding Agent
description: AI coding agent inside VS Code: reads and edits files, runs commands, verifies results with evidence, and asks before risky actions. Bring your own key (Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama).

title: AntiGem VSCode Extension
description: One chat UI for Antigravity (agy), Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode — the AntiGem app (VS Code port of the AntiGem Android app: https://github.com/santoshkurmi/antigem), inside VS Code.

title: Classgrid
description: The Classgrid AI inside Classgrid Code: the Agent chat on the right side, and the AI's terminal, files and memory on this computer.

title: Learnosity Build Aide MCP
description: Build Learnosity integrations directly from your AI coding assistant.

title: Lichess Sidebar
description: Play Lichess games from a small panel in the VS Code sidebar (bottom-left, under the Explorer).

title: Softgaze
description: A calm window to stay with one Claude Code session while it works. Requires the free softgaze app.

title: Anosic Speech Recorder
description: Records your voice, transcribes it with a local AI model, and copies the text to your clipboard.

title: Fix-copilot-RTL
description: Right-to-left (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian) and mixed-direction text support for the VS Code chat panel, including GitHub Copilot Chat: paragraphs, lists, tables, quotes and the input box.

title: Movoa: AI Video Generator with Sound
description: Unlimited AI video generator with sound: on paid plans the tenth take of a shot costs what the first did, and your first clip is free to make right now. This extension generates clips with sound, or animates a workspace image, straight into your project with your Movoa API key.

title: CodeArena — coding games for class
description: Kahoot + Codewars inside VS Code: tug of war, quiz, Codewars, race and find-the-bug games for programming lessons.

title: TensorFlow Keras Pro SnippetsM282
description: A practical collection of 163 VS Code snippets for TensorFlow, Keras, deep learning, computer vision, model training, transfer learning, NLP, and time-series workflows.

title: NBT Plus for VS Code
description: View and edit Minecraft NBT (Java & Bedrock) with a 3D structure viewer for .nbt, .mcstructure, .litematic, .schem and .schematic files, plus region (.mca) support

title: Join Lines with Comma
description: Join lines into one comma-separated line (1,2,3 or 'a','b','c'), in the editor or on the clipboard.

title: Shell Script Buttons
description: Your workspace's .sh scripts as a grid of buttons in the sidebar. Flags from each script's usage line become input fields.

title: Usage Rings for Claude Code
description: Claude Code's context fill, 5-hour and 7-day limits and session cost in the status bar, each in its own colour.
